title: Lemon & Oregano Chicken Traybake
blurb: One roasting tin of chicken thighs, potatoes and lemon — skin crisps up, everything else looks after itself.
method: Heat oven to 200°C.
Toss potatoes, onion and garlic with half the oil in a roasting tin; roast 15 min.
Add chicken thighs, remaining oil, oregano, salt and pepper, and lemon wedges. Toss to coat.
Roast 30–35 min until chicken is golden and potatoes are tender.
Scatter with olives and parsley before serving.
Serve with a simple green salad.

title: Baked Sea Bream with Fennel & Orange
blurb: Whole fish over shaved fennel and orange — bakes in one dish, tastes like a coastal holiday.
ingredients: 1 whole sea bream, gutted and scaled
60g rocket or mixed salad leaves, to serve
method: Heat oven to 200°C. Parboil the potatoes 8 min until just tender; drain.
Toss fennel and potatoes with half the oil and a pinch of salt in a baking dish.
Score the fish 2–3 times each side; stuff cavities with orange slices, garlic and dill.
Lay fish over the fennel and potatoes, drizzle with remaining oil and orange juice.
Bake 25–30 min until the fish flakes easily and potatoes are tender.
Serve with rocket or salad leaves.

title: Shakshuka with Feta & Herbs
blurb: Eggs poached in a spiced tomato and pepper sauce — a fast, protein-rich dinner (or breakfast-for-dinner).
method: Soften onion and pepper in oil, 6–7 min. Add garlic and spices, cook 1 min.
Pour in tomatoes, simmer 8 min until thickened.
Make three wells in the sauce, crack in eggs, cover and cook 6–8 min until whites are set.
Scatter with feta and herbs.
Serve with warm crusty bread for dipping.

title: Lamb & Chickpea Kofta with Tzatziki
blurb: Spiced lamb skewers with a cooling cucumber-yoghurt sauce and a crunchy chopped salad.
ingredients: 1/2 x 400g tin chickpeas, drained and mashed
method: Mix lamb, mashed chickpeas, spices, onion and seasoning; shape onto skewers.
Grill or pan-fry 10–12 min, turning, until cooked through.
Stir grated cucumber (squeezed dry), garlic and mint into yoghurt for tzatziki.
Warm the pittas.
Serve with the salad and warmed pittas.

title: Tonno e Fagioli (White Bean & Tuna Salad)
blurb: A five-minute Italian pantry salad — good tinned tuna, cannellini beans, red onion and lemon.
ingredients: 1 x 160g tin good-quality tuna in olive oil
method: Soak sliced onion in the lemon juice for 10 min to mellow it.
Toss beans, tuna (with its oil), onion, lemon juice, olive oil and parsley.
Season well and serve over rocket with tomatoes and crusty bread.

title: Roasted Vegetable, Chickpea & Halloumi Bowl
blurb: Traybake vegetables and chickpeas with griddled halloumi and a lemon-tahini drizzle.
method: Heat oven to 200°C. Toss vegetables and chickpeas with oil and cumin; roast 25 min.
Meanwhile cook the couscous according to packet instructions; fluff with a fork.
Griddle halloumi slices 2 min per side until golden.
Whisk tahini with lemon juice and a splash of water to a drizzling consistency.
Assemble bowls over the couscous and drizzle over.

title: Joojeh Kabab (Saffron-Lime Chicken Skewers)
blurb: Yoghurt-and-saffron marinated chicken, grilled until charred, with tomatoes and flatbread.
ingredients: Pinch saffron, bloomed in 1 tbsp hot water
method: Mix yoghurt, saffron water, grated onion, citrus juice and oil; marinate chicken at least 2 hours (or overnight).
Thread onto skewers with tomatoes.
Cook the rice according to packet instructions.
Grill or griddle skewers 12–15 min, turning, until charred and cooked through.
Serve over rice with the warmed flatbread and diced cucumber.

title: Kuku Sabzi (Herb & Walnut Frittata)
blurb: A dense, deeply green herb frittata — parsley, coriander and dill baked with eggs and walnuts.
ingredients: Sliced tomatoes and cucumber, to serve
method: Heat oven to 180°C. Whisk eggs with turmeric and seasoning.
Stir in all the chopped herbs, spring onion and walnuts.
Pour into an oiled ovenproof pan, bake 22–25 min until just set.
Cool slightly and cut into wedges; good warm or cold.
Serve with warmed flatbread, yoghurt and sliced tomatoes and cucumber.

title: Persian-Spiced Salmon with Saffron & Barberries
blurb: Salmon fillets glazed with saffron and lime, finished with tart barberries and pistachio.
ingredients: Pinch saffron, bloomed in 1 tbsp hot water
method: Cook the rice according to packet instructions.
Mix saffron water, oil and lime juice; brush over salmon.
Pan-fry or bake fillets 8–10 min until just cooked.
Meanwhile steam the green beans 4–5 min until just tender.
Soak barberries in warm water 5 min, drain, and scatter over with pistachios.
Serve salmon and green beans over the rice.

title: Adas Polo-Style Lentil Rice with Spiced Beef
blurb: Basmati layered with spiced lentils, dates and crispy onions, topped with cinnamon-spiced ground beef.
ingredients: Sliced cucumber and tomato, to serve
method: Cook lentils in salted water 15–18 min until just tender; drain.
Parboil rice 6 min, drain.
Fry sliced onion in 1 tbsp oil until deep golden and crisp; set aside.
Brown beef with diced onion and spices, 8–10 min.
Layer rice and lentils in a pan with remaining oil, dates and raisins; steam 15 min on low heat, lid wrapped in a tea towel.
Serve topped with beef and crispy onions, with sliced cucumber and tomato alongside.

title: Herb & Bean Stew (Ghormeh Sabzi-Inspired, Chicken)
blurb: A lighter, chicken-based take on the classic herb stew — parsley, coriander, fenugreek and kidney beans.
ingredients: 1/2 x 400g tin red kidney beans, drained
method: Fry onion in oil until soft; add chicken and brown lightly.
Add chopped herbs and fenugreek, cook 5 min to soften.
Add kidney beans, dried limes (pierced) and enough water to just cover; simmer, covered, 30–35 min.
Meanwhile cook the rice according to packet instructions.
Season to taste and serve over rice.

title: Ginger-Scallion Steamed Sea Bass
blurb: Cantonese-style whole fish steamed until silky, topped with sizzling ginger and spring onion oil.
ingredients: 1 whole sea bass, scaled and gutted
method: Cook the rice according to packet instructions.
Score the fish, place on a heatproof plate with half the ginger inside the cavity.
Steam over boiling water 10–12 min until just cooked, steaming or stir-frying the greens alongside for the last 3–4 min.
Scatter remaining ginger and spring onion over the fish; pour over soy sauce and wine.
Heat oil until smoking and pour over to sizzle.
Serve over rice with the greens.

title: Miso-Glazed Salmon with Sesame Greens
blurb: A sticky three-ingredient miso glaze under the grill, with quick sesame-garlic greens.
method: Cook the rice according to packet instructions.
Mix miso, honey and vinegar; spread over salmon and marinate 10 min if time allows.
Grill salmon 8–10 min until glazed and cooked through.
Stir-fry greens with garlic and sesame oil 3–4 min.
Serve together over rice, scattered with sesame seeds.

title: Chicken & Vegetable Stir-Fry with Brown Rice
blurb: A everyday wok dinner — lean chicken, crunchy vegetables, a light garlic-ginger sauce.
method: Cook the rice according to packet instructions.
Stir-fry chicken in hot oil until golden, 5–6 min; set aside.
Stir-fry vegetables 3–4 min until just tender-crisp.
Return chicken, add ginger, garlic, soy and oyster sauce; toss 1–2 min.
Serve over brown rice.

title: Beef & Broccoli Lettuce Wraps
blurb: Quick stir-fried beef and broccoli in a light sauce, wrapped in crisp lettuce instead of rice.
method: Toss beef with cornflour and a splash of soy sauce.
Stir-fry beef in hot oil 2–3 min until browned; set aside.
Stir-fry broccoli 3 min, add ginger, garlic, remaining soy and vinegar.
Return beef, toss to coat, and serve in lettuce leaves.

title: Tofu & Vegetable Red Curry
blurb: A fresh Thai-style curry — coconut milk, red curry paste, firm tofu and whatever vegetables are in the fridge.
ingredients: 1/2 tbsp fish sauce (or soy for vegetarian)
method: Cook the rice according to packet instructions.
Fry curry paste in a dry pan 1 min until fragrant, then stir in coconut milk.
Add pepper and green beans, simmer 8 min.
Add tofu, fish sauce and lime juice, simmer 5 min more.
Top with basil and serve with rice.

title: Thai Chicken Larb Salad
blurb: Minced chicken tossed with lime, fish sauce, chilli, mint and toasted rice powder — bright and light.
ingredients: Little gem lettuce leaves, to serve
method: Dry-fry chicken mince in a hot pan, breaking it up, until cooked, 6–8 min.
Off the heat, stir in fish sauce, lime juice, chilli and shallots.
Toss through herbs and rice powder just before serving.
Serve in lettuce cups with cucumber slices.

title: Vietnamese Turmeric Fish with Dill (Cha Ca)
blurb: Firm white fish pan-fried with turmeric and dill, finished with peanuts and fresh herbs over rice noodles.
ingredients: 250g firm white fish (cod or haddock), cubed
method: Marinate fish with turmeric, ginger, garlic and fish sauce for 15 min.
Cook the rice noodles according to packet instructions; drain.
Pan-fry fish in oil 3–4 min until nearly cooked.
Add spring onion and dill, toss 1–2 min until fish is just done.
Serve over rice noodles with beansprouts and lettuce leaves, scattered with peanuts.

title: Grilled Fish Tacos with Cabbage Slaw
blurb: Charred spiced white fish, crunchy lime slaw and a light yoghurt crema in warm corn tortillas.
method: Rub fish with paprika, cumin, half the lime juice and seasoning; grill or pan-fry 3–4 min per side.
Toss cabbage and carrot with remaining lime juice.
Mix yoghurt with chipotle for the crema.
Warm tortillas, flake in fish, top with slaw, crema and coriander.

title: Chicken Tinga Lettuce & Corn Cups
blurb: Shredded chicken simmered in a smoky chipotle-tomato sauce — served in lettuce or warm tortillas.
method: Poach chicken in water until cooked, 12–15 min; shred with two forks.
Soften onion and garlic in oil, add tomatoes, chipotle and cumin, simmer 10 min.
Stir in shredded chicken, simmer 5 min more to absorb the sauce.
Serve in lettuce cups or tortillas with avocado and warmed black beans.

title: Black Bean & Sweet Potato Tacos
blurb: Roasted spiced sweet potato and black beans, lime crema and pickled red onion in soft tortillas.
method: Heat oven to 200°C. Toss sweet potato with spices and oil; roast 25 min until tender.
Soak red onion in lime juice 10 min to quick-pickle.
Warm black beans through.
Fill tortillas with sweet potato, beans, pickled onion, yoghurt and coriander.

title: Carne Asada with Pico de Gallo & Charred Corn
blurb: Citrus-marinated grilled steak, sliced thin, with a fresh tomato-lime salsa and blackened corn.
method: Marinate steak in lime juice, garlic, cumin and a little oil for 30 min to overnight.
Mix tomatoes, onion, jalapeño, coriander and a squeeze of lime for pico de gallo.
Grill steak 3–4 min per side (medium), rest 5 min, then slice thinly against the grain.
Char corn on the grill or a dry pan; serve alongside with warmed tortillas.

title: Shrimp & Avocado Ceviche
blurb: Prawns and citrus juice 'cook' together with tomato, chilli and avocado — no stove needed.
method: Cover chopped prawns in lime and lemon juice; chill 15–20 min until opaque ('cooked' by the acid).
Drain off most of the juice, then fold through tomato, onion, jalapeño and coriander.
Fold in avocado just before serving.
Serve chilled with tortilla chips.

title: Chipotle Chicken & Vegetable Skewers
blurb: Smoky marinated chicken and peppers on the grill, finished with lime and a scatter of coriander.
method: Cook the rice according to packet instructions.
Marinate chicken in chipotle, lime juice, oil and cumin for at least 20 min.
Thread chicken and vegetables onto skewers.
Grill 12–14 min, turning, until charred and cooked through.
Finish with a squeeze of lime and coriander, and serve over rice.
